117737.name: Regional Offices of Chabad-Lubavitch of the Pacific Northwest & Seattle
117737.note: Lubavitch.com, 23 Jan 2003: Rabbi Sholom-Ber Levitin and his wife Chanie 'were serving as Chabad representatives since October of 1972' in Seattle. The heads' sources (shetach history) put his start in Kislev 5733 (7 Nov - 5 Dec 1972).

118195.name: Eastside Torah Center - Chabad
118195.note: Lubavitch.com, 23 Jan 2003: 'When Rabbi Sholom-Ber Levitin recruited Mordechai and Rochie Farkash to bring Chabad to Bellevue and the surrounding suburbs on Seattle's East side in 1994'; they had been renting space one block from Microsoft headquarters 'since 1994'.

118598.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Clark County
118598.note: The Columbian, 28 Apr 2013: 'It's been 10 years since Rabbi Shmulik and Tzivie Greenberg traveled from Brooklyn to make Vancouver their home', marking the centre's decade. CrownHeights.info, 23 June 2006 (the centre's opening on June 11): 'It was only three years ago that he and his wife, Tzivie, moved to Vancouver and started holding Shavuot services in their living room'.

164329.name: Chabad of the Central Cascades
164329.note: Lubavitch.com, 17 Sept 2009: 'In the summer of 2005, Rabbi Shalom Dovber (Berry) and Nechama Farkash arrived in Central Cascades.' Medium: its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on 25 Aug 2004.

4080577.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Renton
4080577.note: CrownHeights.info, 23 Oct 2018: 'In late August, Rabbi Yisroel and Shternie (née Shemtov) Treitel opened Chabad of Renton under the auspices of Rabbi Sholom Ber Levitin'. Its chabad.org listing went up 21 Aug 2018.
